parameters.content:
## Vera 05 · 04 Evening gap list
7 PM, three days before the visit until the day before: what is still missing goes to the contractor, and a one-line readiness note goes to the engineer.

Generated from `n8n/mobilise/workflows.mjs`. Edit there and rebuild; edits made here are overwritten on the next import.
Each node's note says what it does and which guardrails it carries.

nodes.name: Sites in paper-check window

parameters.query:
select mo.id as mobilisation_id, row_to_json(mo) as mob,
  (select json_agg(json_build_object('code', code, 'area', area, 'text', text, 'when', "when", 'severity', severity, 'evidence', evidence, 'status', status, 'reason', reason) order by code) from lines where mobilisation_id = mo.id) as lines,
  c.id as contact_id, c.language as lang, extract(epoch from c.last_inbound_at) * 1000 as last_inbound_ms,
  (select id from contacts where mobilisation_id = mo.id and role = 'engineer' limit 1) as engineer_contact_id
from mobilisations mo join contacts c on c.mobilisation_id = mo.id and c.role = 'contractor'
where mo.phase = 'paper' and (mo.id = nullif($1, '')::bigint or ($1 = '' and mo.visit_date between current_date and current_date + 3));

nodes.notes:
Every site whose visit is in the next 3 days (or the one that asked).
Guardrails: retry

nodes.name: One site at a time
nodes.notes: A failure on one site does not stop the others.

nodes.name: Build gap list
nodes.notes: Missing papers by severity, what was sent back and why, how many site photos so far. In the contractor's language.

nodes.name: Send to contractor

value.request: ={{ { body: { type: "text", text: { preview_url: false, body: $json.gap.text } }, template: $json.gap.template } }}

nodes.notes:
Free inside 24 h of their last message; otherwise the approved utility template.
Guardrails: window

nodes.name: Tell the engineer

value.request: ={{ { body: { type: 'text', text: { body: $('Build gap list').item.json.gap.engineer_line } }, template: { name: 'vera_mob_engineer_brief', language: 'en', params: [$('Build gap list').item.json.gap.engineer_line] } } }}
